description: This file contains source code for integrating Vue components into a testing or rendering environment within a Playwright-based project. It defines functions for creating, mounting, updating, and unmounting Vue components, including support for JSX and object-based components, as well as handling slots and event listeners.

methods.name: isObjectComponent
methods.description: Checks if a given component is an ObjectComponent based on a specific type property.

methods.name: isJsxComponent
methods.description: Checks if a given component is a JsxComponent based on a specific type property.

methods.name: __pwCreateChild
methods.description: Recursively processes a child element, wrapping JSX and object components for Vue rendering.

methods.name: __pwCreateSlot
methods.description: Compiles a string of HTML into a Vue render function for slot content.

methods.name: __pwSlotToFunction
methods.description: Converts slot input (string, array of strings) into a render function for Vue slots.

methods.name: __pwJsxChildArray
methods.description: Extracts children from a JSX component, returning an array if present.

methods.name: __pwCreateComponent
methods.description: Constructs a Vue component wrapper from a custom component object, handling props, slots, and listeners.

methods.name: __pwWrapFunctions
methods.description: Wraps slot functions into a form compatible with Vue's slot API.

methods.name: __pwCreateWrapper
methods.description: Creates a Vue Virtual Node (VNode) wrapper for a component with attached event listeners.
